name: detailed
description: A detailed guided tour that walks through the approved twelve storyboard sections using fictional Prompt Vault Pro beta content.

scenes.narration: Begin in the library to orient beta testers around saved prompts, recent activity, and the workspace they will revisit most often.
scenes.caption: Start from the main library.

scenes.narration: Pause on the app sign-in page to explain that the beta tour avoids personal account menus and keeps every visible detail privacy-safe.
scenes.caption: Use the safe app sign-in screen.

scenes.narration: Open a new prompt to show the clean starting point before any title, description, or reusable instructions are filled in.
scenes.caption: Open a blank prompt editor.

scenes.narration: Add the Restaurant Menu Improvement title, the restaurant category, and the reusable consultant prompt so the prompt is clear and easy to share.
scenes.caption: Complete the fictional demo prompt.

scenes.narration: After saving, review the detail page to confirm the prompt looks polished, readable, and ready for later use.
scenes.caption: Review the saved prompt page.

scenes.narration: Return to the library and point out the recently added area so new prompts feel easy to spot after saving.
scenes.caption: Spot the prompt in Recently added.

scenes.narration: Use search for the word menu to show that saved prompts stay easy to retrieve without rebuilding them from scratch.
scenes.caption: Search and retrieve the prompt fast.

scenes.narration: Open the prompt again from search results to reinforce the single source of truth for reusable prompt instructions.
scenes.caption: Reopen the prompt detail view.

scenes.narration: Show the knowledge files area and add the fictional sample menu so supporting context stays attached to the prompt.
scenes.caption: Attach the fictional menu file.

scenes.narration: Visit version history to explain how prompt changes remain visible and recoverable as teams refine their best instructions.
scenes.caption: Review prompt version history.

scenes.narration: Browse templates to show how Prompt Vault Pro can jump-start new workflows with reusable structures instead of blank pages.
scenes.caption: Browse reusable prompt templates.

scenes.narration: Finish on import to show the path for bringing existing prompts into the library and expanding the collection over time.
scenes.caption: Import prompts into the library.
